name: Brick
description: Small rectangular blocks typically made of fired or sun-dried clay

name: Cardboard
description: Pasteboard or stiff paper

name: Carpet/rug
description: Floor or stair covering made from thick woven fabric

name: Ceramic
description: Hard brittle material produced from nonmetallic minerals by firing at high temperature

name: Concrete
description: Strong hard building material composed of sand and gravel and cement and water

name: Fabric/cloth
description: Artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers

name: Fire
description: Combustion of materials producing heat and light

name: Foliage
description: Plant leaves, flowers, and branches

name: Food
description: Nutritious substance that people or animals eat or drink

name: Fur
description: Short, fine, soft hair of certain animals

name: Glass
description: Hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent

name: Granite
description: Plutonic igneous rock having visibly crystalline texture.  Note that laminate that looks like granite should be labeled as 'Granite'

name: Hair
description: Threadlike strands growing from the skin of people

name: Laminate
description: Composite made of plastic resin and cellulose paper with a decorative finish.  If it is designed to look like another surface, please select that name instead

name: Leather
description: Animal skin made smooth and flexible by removing the hair and then tanning

name: Marble
description: Hard crystalline metamorphic rock that takes a high polish, typically with streaks of color

name: Metal
description: Solid material that is typically hard, shiny, malleable, fusible, and ductile

name: Mirror
description: Polished surface that reflects a clear image

name: Painted
description: Surface covered with a layer of opaque paint (e.g. acrylic or latex paint)

name: Paper/tissue
description: Thin sheets from the pulp of wood or other fibrous substances

name: Plastic - clear
description: Transparent synthetic material made from a wide range of organic polymers (does transmit light)

name: Plastic - opaque
description: Opaque synthetic material made from a wide range of organic polymers (does not transmit light)

name: Rubber/latex
description: Elastic material obtained from the latex sap of trees

name: Skin
description: Thin layer of tissue forming the natural outer covering of the body of a person or animal

name: Sky
description: The atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth

name: Sponge
description: Porous mass of interlacing fibers used to absorb water

name: Stone
description: Hard, solid, nonmetallic mineral matter of which rock is made

name: Tile
description: Flat thin rectangular slab used to cover surfaces.  Note that laminate that looks like tile should be labeled as 'Tile'

name: Wallpaper
description: Decorative paper for the walls of rooms

name: Water
description: Liquid found in lakes and rivers

name: Wax
description: Insoluble compounds that are malleable near ambient temperatures

name: Wicker
description: Interlaced slender branches

name: Wood
description: Hard fibrous substance under the bark of trees.  Note that laminate that looks like wood should be labeled as 'Wood'
